text:
**Why the pictures were missing.** The post names them by their place in the kit repo (docs/cl10/...). Here in the Artifact, a picture named that way is looked up in its board's picture list, and the kit board had none: repos/board/kit_docs/_index did not exist. On top of that, the page read only one board's list, the first it found (Harmonize's), so a kit-board picture could never be found under All boards. The kit's sync tool could not even write a list for an attached board.

What I did: the 12 pictures are uploaded to this Artifact and listed in the kit board's own list (done now). The tool now writes an attached board's list where the page reads it, and the page reads every board's list. The last two are on branch `cl10-fix`. Until the page is republished, the pictures show when you pick the kit board in the header switcher; once it is republished, under All boards too.

**The resize gestures, as they were on the phone:** only a two-finger pinch on a picture. In a computer-vs-phone row the pinch changes only the row's width, and that width was capped at the screen width, so pinching out could not make the pairs bigger or taller (your 'can't resize downwards'). The edge-drag resize of inline viewers works only with a mouse, and only on screens 720 px or wider. The pinch also re-laid the row on every finger move, hence the glitches.

**Now (on `cl10-fix`):**
- Under each picture row there is a short grabber line: drag it down with a finger to enlarge the row, up to shrink it. With a mouse, the same edge shows the up-down resize cursor.
- On a phone a row can grow to 2.6 times its width; it then scrolls sideways inside its own box, and the page never does.
- A pinch still works, laid out once per frame.
- Sizes are remembered per device.

Checked on an emulated iPhone 13 with real touch events: 12 of 12 pictures load, a 160 px drag takes a row from 311 to 467 px, and dragging back returns it to 308 px. Your own phone is the real test once the page is republished.
